title: Analytics
description: How your bookings, customers and calendar are doing, and what changed since the previous period.

invalid.missing: Choose both a start and an end date for a custom range.
invalid.order: The start date must be on or before the end date.
invalid.tooLong: Custom ranges can cover at most {max} days.

filters.label: Filters
filters.errorMissing: Choose a start and an end date.
filters.errorTooLong: Choose a range of at most {max} days.

empty.title: No appointments in this period
empty.description: Once customers book, you’ll see trends, your busiest times and where bookings come from. Try a longer date range, or share your booking page to get started.
empty.filteredDescription: Try a different team member or service, or widen the date range.

definitions.bookings: Appointments scheduled in the period (excluding cancelled).
definitions.cancellationRate: Cancelled ÷ all appointments scheduled in the period.
definitions.noShowRate: No-shows ÷ appointments that reached an outcome (completed + no-show).
definitions.revenue: Sum of service prices for completed appointments. Appointments complete automatically once they end, unless cancelled or marked as a no-show. Customers pay you directly, so this is earned revenue as booked, not money collected by Hournook.
definitions.bookedValue: Sum of service prices for all non-cancelled appointments in the period.
definitions.avgValue: Average service price of completed appointments that have a price.
definitions.newCustomers: Customers whose first (non-cancelled) appointment falls in the period.
definitions.returningCustomers: Customers with an appointment in the period who had visited before it.
definitions.repeatRate: Returning customers ÷ all customers with an appointment in the period.
definitions.utilization: Booked minutes ÷ available working minutes (from opening hours, staff schedules, closures).

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: What stands out in this period, in plain words.
insights.empty: Not enough data yet for insights. They appear once you have a few weeks of bookings.
insights.bookingsUp: Bookings increased by {pct} compared with the previous period ({from} → {to}).
insights.bookingsDown: Bookings decreased by {pct} compared with the previous period ({from} → {to}).
insights.busiestTime: {day} {part, select, morning {mornings are} afternoon {afternoons are} other {evenings are}} your busiest time ({pct} of bookings).
insights.noShows: {pct} of appointments were no-shows. Reminders are on by default; consider adding a 2-hour reminder in Booking settings.
insights.cancellations: {pct} of appointments were cancelled in this period.
insights.inactiveCustomers: {count} customers haven't returned in over 90 days.
